entities.name: Sorine Daabson
entities.description: Sorine Relicbane, a Soldevi machinist from Soldev during the Ice Age branded a heretic for opposing the research of ancient artifacts.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: A machinist researching ancient artifacts whom Sorine opposed.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war whose lessons Sorine said Arcum ignored.

entities.name: Soldevi Adnates
entities.description: Meddlers who caused the Phyrexian war beasts and Steam Beasts to go out of control.

entities.name: Phyrexian war beasts
entities.description: Excavated war beasts that went out of control.

entities.name: Soldevi Steam Beasts
entities.description: Arcum's machines that went out of control.

events.summary: Sorine becomes an outspoken opponent of Arcum Dagsson's research of ancient artifacts, warning of a mechanical utopia.
events.quote: outspoken opponent of the research of ancient artifacts

events.summary: Sorine's fears come true when the excavated Phyrexian war beasts and Soldevi Steam Beasts go out of control through the Adnates' meddling.

relations.quote: outspoken opponent of the research of ancient artifacts by Arcum Dagsson
